comment: Add a strict/no-fresh-fallback mode to the bridge worktree-resume contract (resume_worktree ?strict=true, client.resume_worktree(strict=), 'agent-bridge resume --strict') so a missing bridge record or a failed resume refuse (409 resume_requires_existing_session) instead of silently starting a replacement conversation; agent-dispatch's non-forcing conversation-recovery path (resume_worktree_and_send with allow_takeover=False) now requests it
